name: It Starts with a Summon
source:
You are a Witch/Wizard studying at Athena Academy who must defeat an A-Class Villain in order to graduate. As part of the exam, you may call for a summon to aid you in battle.

Angel, Demon or Elf-- for everyone else they might do. But not for you. 

You decide to call for the All Legendary Ice Dragon! Surely it can't be that hard to do. Greatness runs through your veins and power sparks from your fingers...

Wait-- No. That's not right is it? Maybe it's just for you but... doesn't this dragon seem kind of...humanoid?

Well. Hm. This makes things much more difficult. 

How are you to graduate now??!

[From [url=https://ayperosia.itch.io/it-starts-with-a-summon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名在雅典娜学院学习的女巫/巫师，必须击败A级恶棍才能毕业。作为考试的一部分，你可以召唤召唤来帮助你战斗。

天使、恶魔或精灵——对于他们可能做的其他所有人。但不适合你。

你决定召唤全传奇冰龙！当然，这不可能那么难做到。伟大在你的血管中流淌，力量从你的手指迸发出……

等等——不，这不对吧？也许这只是为了你，但是……这条龙看起来不是有点……人形吗？

出色地。嗯。这让事情变得更加困难。

现在怎么毕业了？？

[来自[url=https://ayperosia.itch.io/it-starts-with-a-summon]itch.io[/url]]
